theme_and_concept.name: Tpt - Vietnamese Food Shop
theme_and_concept.style: Warm, traditional Vietnamese (red/gold/cream), cozy authentic eatery, street food vibe.
theme_and_concept.theme: Light theme is preferred to match the cozy 'rice paper' and bright eatery aesthetic. Use dark red accents to provide contrast and traditional feel.

headings.usage: Use for app name, welcome screen hero text, and primary section titles.

body.usage: Use for dish descriptions, prices, buttons, and all UI text for maximum legibility.

primary.name: Lacquer Red
primary.usage: Main CTAs, Add to Cart buttons, active tab icons.

background.name: Rice Paper Cream
background.usage: Main app background. Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) for the main background to keep the warm, organic feel.

surface.name: Pure White
surface.usage: Dish cards, bottom navigation bar, floating elements. Must use subtle shadows.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-[#D32F2F] text-white px-6 py-3 font-semibold hover:bg-[#B71C1C] transition-colors shadow-md active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-white text-[#D32F2F] border border-[#D32F2F] px-6 py-3 font-semibold hover:bg-[#FFF9F0] transition-colors active:scale-95
buttons.icon: rounded-full p-2 bg-[#FFF9F0] text-[#D32F2F] hover:bg-[#FFE0B2] transition-colors

cards.dish_card: bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(45,36,36,0.05)] flex flex-col gap-3
cards.order_card: bg-white rounded-xl p-4 border border-[#F0E6D8] shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-2

navigation.bottom_tabs: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#F0E6D8] pb-6 pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between items-center z-50
navigation.top_header: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-[#FFF9F0]/90 backdrop-blur-xl px-4 py-3 flex justify-between items-center

chips.category_active: bg-[#D32F2F] text-white px-5 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap shadow-sm
chips.category_inactive: bg-white text-[#5C4D4D] px-5 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap border border-[#F0E6D8]

layouts.global: Mobile-first width constraint. Use max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FFF9F0] relative pb-20 (to account for bottom nav).

home_screen.header: Welcome text, user avatar, and a subtle traditional pattern or icon.
home_screen.categories: Horizontal scroll view (`flex overflow-x-auto gap-3 no-scrollbar py-2`).
home_screen.menu_grid: CSS Grid: `grid grid-cols-2 gap-4` for dishes. Images must be `aspect-square object-cover rounded-xl`.

dish_detail.image: Full width at the top, max-h-[40vh] object-cover rounded-b-3xl shadow-md
dish_detail.content: Padded container with title, price, description. Fixed bottom action bar for 'Add to Cart'.

admin_dashboard.layout: Use dense lists (`flex-col gap-3`) for Customers and Orders. Admin has a separate bottom nav or a sidebar if viewed on desktop, but default to mobile web view.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use on headers and bottom tab nav: `bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b/t border-[#F0E6D8]`.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Keep shadows soft and tinted towards the warm colors. e.g., `shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(211,47,47,0.1)]`.
visual_enhancers.borders: Minimal usage. Use subtle `#F0E6D8` for separators.

motion.interactions: Use `active:scale-95 transition-transform` on all clickable items (cards, buttons).
motion.page_transitions: Framer Motion: fade and slide up (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on red background meets 4.5:1 ratio. Dark brown text for main reading.

welcome_bg.description: Street food vendor cooking at night market. Use for Welcome/Landing screen background with a dark overlay.

banh_mi.description: Traditional Vietnamese bánh mì on local newspaper.

pho.description: Vietnamese phở in white ceramic bowl.

banh_beo.description: Chopsticks over a dish, used to represent Bánh Bèo or other small plate dishes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile web app experience: restrict the main container to max-width (e.g., `max-w-md mx-auto`) with a mobile-style layout.
Implement bottom tab navigation fixed to the bottom of the screen.
Use `.js` files for all React components, not `.tsx`.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or bottom nav. Always use a solid color or glassmorphism (bg-color with opacity + backdrop-blur).
For the login/register system, build a mock JWT authentication flow saving to localStorage or just React state.
Implement a mock cart state for placing orders (COD only).
Ensure the Admin dashboard is accessible via a specific login (e.g., admin@tpt.com) and displays mock customers and orders.

Make heavy use of custom scrollbar hiding utilities (e.g., `.no-scrollbar { -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none; } .no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }`) for horizontal scrolling categories.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.
Never center align the root `.App` container text.
Avoid AI slop: no emoji icons like 🤖, create depth with z-index and shadows, use generous spacing.
Use pill-shaped buttons with hover/active animations.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, links, and inputs.
